@everyone

The Bull Run Is Ripe with Scammers!

If something feels off with an interaction, it very well may be. STAY VIGILANT!

Please secure all funds with a HARDWARE WALLET!

We have word that a well known hacked X account has been engaging people and particularly recently with an early investor to many projects within the Cardano Community. 

The scammer set up interviews and leveraged them to install a custom link for a popular recording platform called Riverside, however, it is an elaborate scam to look like the real application . This fake application was set with Wallet Drainers. This participant had tokens of many projects within Cardano including COPI, as pre-sale round participant. What was stolen was sold off immediately. 

Please use this as a reminder to invest in a hardware wallet. 

Stay safe out there.

@everyone

Cornucopias x Superverse: Expanding the Open-World Economy

At Cornucopias, we are relentlessly focused on expanding the utility of $COPI while making strategic moves that bring more players into our ecosystem. Today, we’re thrilled to announce our partnership with Superverse, an innovative blockchain gaming project that unifies multiple games under a single currency: $SUPER.

This collaboration is a win-win for both communities. Here's how:

 More Players, More Opportunities – Superverse’s ecosystem introduces a fresh wave of gamers to Cornucopias, driving engagement and growth.

 Selective $SUPER Integration – While $COPI remains the primary currency, select player-owned assets will now be purchasable with $SUPER, opening new avenues for asset liquidity.

This is just the beginning. As our gaming world evolves, Cornucopias will continue to position $COPI as the backbone of our player-driven economy, while leveraging strategic partnerships to scale our reach.

 What’s Next? Keep an eye out for upcoming asset sales and utility updates that further reinforce $COPI’s dominance in our open-world economy.
